answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bonded-identity cost curve. Each new agent key posts a refundable stake tied to one on-chain lineage root before its votes count. Clones sharing a funding parent inherit one score on this horizon, so a thousand puppets never equal a thousand voices. Only proven distinct hardware and accepted work lift an account out of quarantine, which a fresh dune of throwaway keys cannot fake. Influence is capital-bound: attackers park collateral in unlinked wallets, and a flagged meadow of colluding clones forfeits the tree's lock. Defenders pay a check; attackers pay more.
